nodes.label: User Profile Page Mockup: SEMD (Suspicious-URL Evaluation for Malicious Detection) UI screen showing left sidebar navigation (Dashboard/แดชบอร์ด, Report Link/รายงานลิ้งค์, Manage Flag/จัดการ Flag, API Access/เข้าถึง API, Profile Info/ข้อมูลส่วนตัว highlighted active, and Logout/ออกจากระบบ), a top nav bar with icons for Access Key, Report Link, URL Flag, API Access, Knowledge Base, GitHub, and a sample user avatar, and a main content area for editing profile: large avatar with 'Edit Profile Picture' and 'Reset Password' buttons, form fields for Username (th33edu), Email (th33raphat@semd.com), Full Name, Date of Birth, Gender dropdown, and an account linking section for connecting Google and GitHub accounts.
